# CodeBlock

A block of code in the code typeface on the code surface, with optional line numbers and highlighted lines. Long lines scroll sideways inside a focusable, named region, or fold onto the next line when `wrap` is on. It does not color syntax: the text is one ink, and `language` is recorded for tools.

**Import:** `import { CodeBlock } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/text-and-data-display/CodeBlock/CodeBlock.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/text-and-data-display/CodeBlock/CodeBlock.stories.jsx` — Overview, WithoutLineNumbers, HighlightedLines, SeparateHighlights, ScrollsLongLines, WrapsLongLines, BlankLines, Interactive

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/text-and-data-display/CodeBlock/CodeBlock.mdx`

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `text` | string | `''` | The code, with lines separated by newlines. |
| `language` | string | — | The language, recorded as a `language- ` class for tools that read it. It does not color the text. |
| `showLineNumbers` | bool | `true` | Whether each line is numbered in a gutter that screen readers skip. |
| `highlight` | string or number or arrayOf | — | Lines to highlight: a string such as "2,4-6", or an array such as [1, 3]. Start and end are announced to screen readers. |
| `wrap` | bool | `false` | Fold long lines onto the next line instead of scrolling sideways. |
| `label` | string | `'Code snippet'` | The name of the scrolling region a screen reader announces. Unused when `wrap` is on. |
| `className` | string | `''` | Extra classes for placement, such as spacing. |
